sophia (Docs): quick ping: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4333 failing preview. Prefetch dashboard panel 404s and some snippets use old keys `trace_hook` and `cost_breakdown`. Can we triage?

ben (Eng): checking logs. panel JSON refs metric `prefetch.lat_v0` which was renamed -> change to `prefetch.latency_ms`.

marta (Observability): I'll update the panel JSON and remove `experimental: true`. Will run dashboard validator.

ylli (SDK): for snippet keys I'll add a tiny normalize helper in snippet-runner to accept both `trace_hook` and `tracehook` for one release, and convert `cost_breakdown` -> `cost.annotation` in examples.

ci-bot: PR 4333  sample-link-check FAILED: 2 broken links, 1 snippet-lint warning. https://ci.redwood-inference.net/ci/4333/logs

ben (Eng): pushed metric id fix and updated embed path for the playground file that moved.

marta (Observability): validator passed after fixes; added `prefetch.enabled: false` for the example. Pushed.

ylli (SDK): pushed shim + updated snippets and tests. Left TODO to remove shim in two releases and noted in changelog.

ci-bot: PR 4333  sample-link-check OK; snippet-lint OK; preview deploy succeeded: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/branches/pr-4333

sophia (Docs): perfect 1 merging after CI green. I'll open a tiny backfill for redirects and add a migration blurb referencing the SDK shim. Thanks team :thumbsup:
